description: Taxonomy validation provenance and lineage mapping

methodology.corpus_scope: Full AppleSupport opening customer inquiries (N=80,250) and full inbound subset (N=131,258)
methodology.validation_mode: Deterministic regex-assisted token matching with boundary guards and manual sample auditing

BATTERY_DRAIN_POWER_CONSUMPTION.justification: Expanded to encompass both update-linked and non-update-linked battery drain (36% of battery complaints did not cite update).

DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT.justification: Validated as core stability bucket; clear boundary established against performance slowdown.

KEYBOARD_TYPING_AUTOCORRECT_ISSUE.justification: Broadened from transient historical letter 'I' bug to permanent keyboard/typing/autocorrect ontology category while maintaining benchmark test slice.

PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY.justification: General latency and UI lag bucket without requiring explicit mention of update keyword.

CONNECTIVITY_WIFI_BLUETOOTH.justification: High volume coherent network connectivity category.

APP_SPECIFIC_MALFUNCTION.justification: High volume distinct application failure bucket.

DATA_LOSS_RECOVERY.justification: Renamed for semantic precision; distinct recovery workflow.

SCREEN_DISPLAY_TOUCH_BIOMETRICS.justification: Expanded from SCREEN_DISPLAY_HARDWARE_SYMPTOM to formally encompass touch digitizer anomalies and biometric authentication sensors (Touch ID, Face ID), avoiding artificial category fragmentation.

HARDWARE_CHARGING_POWER_CABLE.justification: Discovered in Stage B gap analysis (3.06% of corpus) covering cables, ports, and power adapters.

AUDIO_SOUND_SPEAKER_MIC.justification: Discovered in Stage B gap analysis (2.56% of corpus) covering speaker, microphone, AirPods audio defects.

ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ACCESS.justification: Critical authentication and credential recovery bucket.

BILLING_CHARGE_REFUND_DISPUTE.justification: Core financial and subscription dispute category.

ORDER_PURCHASE_SHIPPING_STATUS.justification: Distinct e-commerce fulfillment and shipping status category.

SECURITY_PHISHING_SUSPICIOUS_CONTACT.justification: Retained despite low volume (0.63%) due to critical safety and trust escalation risk gating.

UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT.justification: Transitioned from UNKNOWN_OUT_OF_SCOPE to encompass both non-support content (Category A, 5 inquiries) and genuine support inquiries lacking actionable diagnostic context (Category B, 517 inquiries: bare help cries, pings, media-only attachments, and symptomless frustration rants; measured at 0.65% corpus prevalence).
